original_test_intent: Demonstrate that a transient DDR command/address parity fault on socket0 MC0 channel0 asserts the expected iMC status/alert path, is handled after resume and produces the matching firmware-first FTrace ELog event.
original_method: Identify GNR/DIMM topology and approved injector configuration; preserve logs/settings; enable C/A parity and exact source matrix; capture clean MC shadow/alert baseline; arm MCE/RAS trace before injection; halt/reset injector and issue one socket0/mc0/ch0 CMD-parity event; capture asserted MC/alert fields; go once; correlate serial, bank13/status/extlog_mem_event and recovery; restore trace/BIOS/DFX state.
manual_activity: Intel-qualified owner/FAE maps the channel and injector configuration, controls halt/injection/go/recovery; agent may collect synchronized register, serial and FTrace evidence.
required_inputs: CScripts harness version/hash/license and platform CMD-parity configuration
Expected clean and asserted MC-shadow/alertsignal fields, severity and bank13 status
Expected serial retry/recovery and extlog_mem_event fields/timing
Dedicated window and OOB crash/no-retry recovery
safety_requirements: Dedicated workload-free SUT with live serial/OOB
Preserve logs; clear only approved volatile target registers after baseline
Do not inject when baseline registers are non-clear or target/config is uncertain
Stop on wrong bank/channel/severity, missing alert, hang or crash
One injection/go only; no automatic reinjection/reset
Restore parity/debug/tracing settings and verify health
agent_execution_scope: Observe one approved CMD-parity injection and collect synchronized evidence
Do not select config, inject/retry/reset independently or decide PASS/FAIL

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row163 Wistron-System RAS-00120-V002: approve GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, CScripts version/hash/license, socket0/MC0/ch0/DIMM topology and exact platform `injectCMDParity` configuration; map/restore all BIOS/GRUB/DFX/C-A-parity/FTrace knobs; define clean/asserted mc_status_shadow and alertsignal fields, expected severity, MC bank13/status, serial retry/recovery and extlog_mem_event timing; provide OOB crash/no-retry recovery.

review_improvement: Restores the source register, alert and bank13 FTrace evidence omitted by generic logs and binds the platform-specific injector to one approved configuration.
independent_technical_reasoning: A DDR C/A parity event is identified by the channel-local alert and MCA path, not by a generic parity string. FTrace must be armed before injection or the transient event can be missed. Clean-to-set register deltas, serial handling and bank13 extlog timing together establish causality; trying alternative injector configurations or repeating the event would destroy that attribution and increase crash risk.
